The main takeaway from our work is that
the Netflix Grand Prize can be won by combining several models that are each good in their own way.

the Netflix Prize is not about the best single algorithm, but rather about a good combination of several algorithms, and that a good combination is not a simple average of the predictions of the individual models, but rather a more complicated blending algorithm.
